items.source: Uses of TaskRejectedException in org.springframework.core.task
items.translation: `org.springframework.core.task` 包中 `TaskRejectedException` 的用法

items.source: since the common executors do not support start timeouts
items.translation: 由于通用执行器不支持启动超时

items.source:
This package defines Spring's core TaskExecutor abstraction,
and provides SyncTaskExecutor and SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor implementations.
items.translation: 该包定义了 Spring 的核心 TaskExecutor 抽象，并提供 SyncTaskExecutor 和 SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor 实现。
